title.note: Small heading at the top of the transfer sheet.

backA11y.note: Button on a transfer opened from the entry sheet: go back to it.

from.note: Label of the card for the account the money leaves.

to.note: Label of the card for the account the money arrives in.

legA11y.note: VoiceOver label of one side; role is "From" or "To".

chooseFrom.message: Choose the account the money leaves.
chooseFrom.note: Hint under the cards of a new transfer while the From account is not chosen.

chooseTo.message: Choose the account the money arrives in.
chooseTo.note: Hint under the cards of a new transfer while the To account is not chosen.

chooseAccounts.note: Label of the disabled confirm button until both accounts of a transfer are chosen.

plain.note: Exchange rate line; from/to are currency codes.

manual.note: The receiving amount was typed by hand, so this is the rate it implies.

ecb.note: ECB is the European Central Bank, where the rate comes from.

ecbRate.note: Chip that goes back to the fetched rate after the receiving amount was typed by hand.

editReceiving.note: Keypad key: type the amount that arrives instead.

sameAmount.note: Keypad key while both accounts share a currency: the amount arriving is the same.

editSending.note: Keypad key: type the amount that leaves instead.
